'''Electric Mining Rig''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|Requires power. This mining rig can mine Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore.|Market performance for this facility was mediocre due to its equally mediocre stats.}}
==Usage==
Requires power. This mining rig can mine [[Originium Ore]] and [[Amethyst Ore]].
*Power Use : 5

==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Mining II]]
